scope: One conditional-response-gap feature experiment; same training cases, grouped evaluation, guards, original learners and costs. No collection, live-site writes, or general tooling.
feature: conditional_response_gap_cp, plus its missing indicator. Original150columns stay unchanged; these2columns are appended.
qualification: Same bounded512node legal-capture/SEE method as pilot; search every qualifying accepting capture on any-window-eligible cases, irrespective of truth, cohort, model score, or ec_sacrifice.
branch_choice: Per current/previous complete iteration, opponent-best acceptance minimizes mover evaluation; losing mate before finite cp before winning mate, shorter losses/longer wins preferred by opponent; UCI tie break.
gap: Best minus second response cp, normalized to mover. Missing if chosen accepting branch lacks2finite-cp root scores, any acceptance lacks complete corresponding window, or offer mapping unknown. Mate is never converted into cp; no added gate.

learners: custom64tree depth6 leaf8distinctmoves mtry12 cost5split rawleaf groupbootstrap
sklearnRF128tree depth6 leaf16rows mtry12 unweightedclasses rowbootstrap
evaluation.threshold_rule: Max innerOOF TP with FP<=fixedoriginal reference FP AND wrong-award fraction<=fixedoriginal reference. Same exact-score threshold selection/ties as previous study.
evaluation.selection: Choose among arms by max innerTP then fewerFP; ties prefer original customfixed, original customretuned, originalRF, gapcustom, gapRF. Fixed reference fallback. Outer results never choose cutoff or learner.
evaluation.control: Each original/augmented learner pair has same hyperparameters, training rows, initial weights, guards, fold membership and seed. Custom mtry sqrt(150)=sqrt(152)=12.
evaluation.primary_reporting: Pooled nested held-out counts for each arm, paired differences and selected procedure. No posthoc winner or threshold sweep.
evaluation.sensitivity: Report scores on outer TEST rows excluding every pilot whole group. Training folds may include pilot groups when legal. This is a non-pilot-case breakdown, not new independent validation.
evaluation.final_calibration: Same separate5fold final calibration; train/freeze one selected fullfit. No replay on already-seen654 in this experiment; leave fresh validation for later.

interpretation: Development evidence on repeatedly used corpus.48label-informed pilot examples generated feature hypothesis; nonpilot breakdown does not erase adaptive-study bias. No deployment claim.
stop: No outcome-dependent retries or expanded search/model sweep.
